I have successfully rewritten the test at `test/modules/kudos.spec.ts` to use manual dependency injection, as requested.

The changes include:
*   Removal of NestJS testing module imports and `INestApplication`.
*   Manual instantiation of `PrismaService`, `KudosService`, and `KudosController` in the `beforeAll` hook.
*   Ensuring `prismaService.kudos.deleteMany()` is called in `beforeEach`.
*   Ensuring `prismaService.$disconnect()` is called in `afterAll` while removing any `app.close()` calls.
*   Removal of `app` declaration.

All specified requirements have been met.
